# Minkyu v0.2.0

### New Stuff

- Added Mod Settings inside Muse Dash.
  - Info+
  - Scoreboard Characters
  - Rank Preview
  - SelectiveEffects
  - Each mod can be toggled separately.
- Added support for custom chart dialogue and Cinema background videos.
- Added MDMC leaderboards for custom songs. Viewing scores works, but uploading isn't supported yet.

### Fixes & Changes

- Custom song scores are now saved separately from the original game.
- Removed MuseDashUnlockDLC.

### Installation

Supports Muse Dash 6.7.0 (build 626, ARM64) on Android 7.0+.

Download `Minkyu.apk` below and follow the setup instructions. If you're updating, install the new APK over your existing Minkyu app and run game setup again.

Some custom charts may crash when opening. If you run into any crashes or bugs, DM me on Discord: `minkyu._.`
